objective: Evolve WCSEO from an evidence-governed SEO diagnosis and orchestration system into a persistent, evidence-governed, self-improving SEO operations system that can progress selected capabilities through read-only, shadow, draft-write, canary-write, and bounded-autonomous maturity without weakening existing product, evidence, security, review, rollback, or claim boundaries.
phase_close_requires: planned versus actual implementation audit completed
focused and impacted regression tests pass
security and adverse-state checks pass where applicable
rollback or safe containment is demonstrated
outcome verification is recorded as PASS, PENDING, or NOT_RUN only when the horizon is not yet observable
scope: persistent site identity, Brand Truth, site state, action, outcome, hypothesis, and experiment contracts
provider-neutral SEO intelligence and governed live-read provider integrations
SERP forensic intelligence, information architecture, internal linking, opportunity scoring, content rescue, and mission planning
R&D, attribution, site-local learning, and evidence-governed rule promotion
write-safety contracts, draft/staging integrations, production canaries, and bounded autonomous action classes
independent Local/GBP, GEO/AIO, authority, and social-distribution extension lanes
exclusions: changing the current read-only flagship audit into an autonomous write command
claiming provider, ranking, traffic, conversion, AI-citation, local-pack, or revenue outcomes without the required live or operational evidence
PBNs, manipulative paid links, automated reciprocal-link schemes, cloaking, fake reviews, fake locations, parasite abuse, fake community conversations, or other search spam
a global autonomy switch that permits unreviewed write classes to skip individual maturity gates

phases.title: Authority, baseline, and expansion contract
phases.objective: Establish one machine-validated expansion program anchored to the current repository authority without changing the flagship product proof boundary or permitting direct merge.
non_goals: main-branch mutation outside the approved PR process
acceptance_criteria: The program is schema-valid and rejects phase skipping, multiple active phases, direct merge, premature write maturity, and missing safety controls.
The repository validator executes the autonomous expansion validator and mutation tests cover material program bypasses.
Existing owner-controlled remediation, product contract, command authority, and capability authority remain canonical and unweakened.
phases.rollback: Revert the Phase 0 schema, program, validator, tests, ledger, and repository-validator hook as one bounded PR if any existing governance or validation behavior regresses.
stop_conditions: Current repository authority cannot be resolved unambiguously.
The new program requires weakening an existing product, security, evidence, reviewer, or rollback gate.
Repository validation cannot run the new control without breaking existing validation semantics.

phases.title: Site profile and Brand Truth contracts
phases.objective: Create evidence-governed site identity, Brand Truth, site-state, action, outcome, hypothesis, and experiment contracts before introducing persistent behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Schemas reject malformed, duplicate, contradictory, stale, unsupported-public, and sensitive-leakage fixtures where applicable.
Every public-use Brand Truth fact has explicit provenance, state, review timing, and use permission.
phases.rollback: Revert the new contracts and fixtures without altering existing session-state or runtime contracts.
stop_conditions: A proposed field duplicates an existing canonical contract without a justified extension path.
Sensitive-data handling cannot be expressed without weakening current redaction rules.

phases.title: Persistent site state, action ledger, and outcome store
phases.objective: Implement bounded persistent site-level memory for approved evidence references, active experiments, actions, outcomes, and risks without replacing session state or persisting secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Atomicity, corruption handling, concurrency, redaction, retention, deletion, and schema-version boundaries are fixture verified.
Secrets and unnecessary personal data cannot enter persisted site state through supported write paths.
phases.rollback: Disable the new site-level persistence and revert its modules while leaving existing runtime session memory unchanged.
stop_conditions: Atomic or recoverable persistence cannot be demonstrated.
The implementation requires storing secrets or uncontrolled raw provider payloads.

phases.title: Provider-neutral SEO intelligence contracts
phases.objective: Define provider-neutral read contracts for SERP, keyword, rendered content, rank, backlink, local maps, and AI visibility evidence while preserving provider semantics and cost provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures cover empty, partial, stale, malformed, timeout, rate-limit, pagination, unsupported-market, cost-ceiling, and unavailable-provider states.
Provider-specific metrics retain their native semantics unless equivalence is proven.
phases.rollback: Revert new provider-neutral interfaces before any provider implementation depends on them.
stop_conditions: The abstraction erases provider-specific semantics required for truthful downstream decisions.
The contract bypasses existing AdapterResult or runtime tool governance without an approved architecture change.

phases.title: DataForSEO and rendered-content acquisition
phases.objective: Implement governed DataForSEO live-read capabilities and per-URL rendered-content fallback with cost approval, provenance, partial coverage, and authorized smoke evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture and adverse tests prove cost ceilings, pagination, partial failures, and per-URL parser provenance.
An authorized redacted live-read smoke certifies only the exact implemented capability set.
phases.rollback: Disable the provider pack and fall back to previously approved local/export evidence paths without changing downstream contracts.
stop_conditions: Current provider authentication or tool semantics cannot be verified.
Cost cannot be bounded before calls.
Live authorization or credentials are unavailable for G3 certification.

phases.title: SERP forensic intelligence and information architecture
phases.objective: Convert approved search evidence into competitor landscape, intent, missing-spoke, cannibalization, and bidirectional internal-link intelligence through existing WCSEO specialist ownership.
non_goals: copying competitor headings as a rule
creating pages solely because competitors have them
acceptance_criteria: Observed SERP evidence feeds existing content relevance and brief gates without creating a competing content authority.
Missing-spoke and link recommendations expose evidence coverage, duplicate-intent risk, and user-value rationale.
phases.rollback: Remove the new research commands and analysis services while preserving existing content brief and IA skills.
stop_conditions: The implementation duplicates an existing content or IA source of truth.
Incomplete competitor coverage is being represented as complete evidence.

phases.title: SEO opportunity engine
phases.objective: Generate and explain prioritized SEO opportunities using business value, evidence, confidence, effort, risk, reversibility, strategic fit, urgency, dependencies, and measurement quality before any autonomous selection.
acceptance_criteria: The opportunity queue is reproducible and every score exposes its evidence, unknowns, and configurable WCSEO heuristics.
Shadow comparisons against specialist judgement identify and calibrate material ranking errors before action selection.
phases.rollback: Disable opportunity ranking and return to existing strategist prioritization without losing collected evidence.
stop_conditions: Scoring cannot distinguish missing evidence from low opportunity value.
The engine presents heuristic weights as search-engine truth.

phases.title: R&D, attribution, and site-local learning
phases.objective: Create controlled hypothesis, experiment, attribution, and local-learning infrastructure that prevents correlation, industry commentary, or one-off wins from becoming canonical SEO rules.
acceptance_criteria: Experiments encode treatment, control or justified alternative, metrics, horizon, confounders, stop conditions, and promotion or rejection criteria.
Observed outcomes and causal confidence remain separate fields and local learnings cannot silently become canonical rules.
phases.rollback: Revert the experimental learning layer while retaining immutable action and outcome observations already collected under approved retention rules.
stop_conditions: The experiment design would intentionally expose revenue-critical pages to unbounded risk.
The learning path bypasses AI Principal SEO Scientist or Scrummaster rule-promotion governance.

phases.title: Daily SEO mission planner in shadow mode
phases.objective: Assemble site state, evidence freshness, opportunity scoring, experiment conflict checks, risk budgets, and Scrummaster challenge into a no-write daily mission planner that may return NO_CHANGE_RECOMMENDED.
acceptance_criteria: Shadow cycles are compared against independent specialist judgement and material disagreements are recorded and used for calibration.
The planner can safely return NO_CHANGE_RECOMMENDED and cannot bypass active-experiment or risk-budget controls.
phases.rollback: Disable the mission-planner workflow and continue using individual read-only commands and existing strategist routing.
stop_conditions: The planner requires hard-coded workflow branching that violates current architecture constraints without review.
Shadow decisions repeatedly fail independent specialist challenge without an architectural correction.

phases.title: Evidence-bound content and content rescue
phases.objective: Enhance existing content workflows with live research, Brand Truth, independent source retrieval, claim-to-source validation, content rescue, drafting, and rewrite artifacts while keeping output local and unpublishing.
non_goals: treating a URL as proof of a claim
acceptance_criteria: Content drafts preserve Brand Truth and map material factual claims to retrieved or supplied evidence states without fabricating support.
Rescue workflows compare technical, performance, SERP, content, link, and cannibalization evidence before recommending rewrites.
phases.rollback: Remove the new draft/rescue commands while preserving existing content quality, brief, decay, compare, verify, and humanize commands.
stop_conditions: Independent source retrieval cannot be bounded safely.
Generated content can bypass current compliance, public-writing, or information-gain gates.

phases.title: External write-safety architecture
phases.objective: Create a separate fail-closed write contract with idempotency, preconditions, approval receipts, bounded change budgets, indeterminate-outcome handling, rollback, and durable write receipts before any real external mutation.
acceptance_criteria: Adverse fixtures cover timeout before send, timeout after remote mutation, lost response, duplicate retry, stale precondition, concurrent mutation, partial write, 429, 5xx, auth failure, wrong target, cost breach, receipt loss, and rollback failure.
No write class can execute without its declared approval, budget, precondition, and receipt contract.
phases.rollback: Remove the new write dispatch path entirely; existing read-only ToolDispatcher behavior remains unchanged.
stop_conditions: A write outcome can become unknown without a safe blocked state and reconciliation path.
A supported write can retry without idempotency or explicit reconciliation.
Current security review rejects the write boundary.

phases.title: CMS and codebase draft or staging adapters
phases.objective: Prove authorized external draft or staging mutation through WCSEO-native WordPress and Git-backed adapters without permitting autonomous production publication.
acceptance_criteria: At least one approved CMS or Git-backed adapter produces a durable authorized draft/staging write receipt and verified resulting state.
Draft/staging capability cannot be mistaken for production publication or SEO outcome evidence.
phases.rollback: Delete or revert the authorized draft/staging artifact using the provider-specific rollback path and disable the adapter if reconciliation fails.
stop_conditions: Required owner authorization or credentials are unavailable.
Provider semantics cannot support idempotent draft/staging reconciliation.
Rollback cannot be demonstrated.

phases.title: Production canary writes
phases.objective: Prove one separately authorized low-risk production action class on the smallest safe noncritical scope with complete before state, write receipt, rollback, immediate verification, and scheduled outcome observation.
non_goals: simultaneously increasing action complexity and blast radius
high-risk robots, canonical, redirect, noindex, pricing, checkout, regulated-content, GBP ownership, or deletion changes
acceptance_criteria: The canary is separately authorized, affects only the approved noncritical scope, and produces a reconciled before/write/after/rollback evidence chain.
A failed or ambiguous canary blocks promotion and reopens the owning write-safety or adapter phase rather than being averaged into success.
phases.rollback: Execute the pre-authorized canary rollback immediately on failed verification or material adverse effect, preserve evidence, and block that write class pending re-audit.
stop_conditions: Explicit production-write authorization is absent.
A safe noncritical canary target cannot be identified.
The write receipt or resulting state is indeterminate.
Rollback fails or cannot be rehearsed.

phases.title: Bounded autonomous SEO operations
phases.objective: Promote only individually proven low-risk action classes to bounded autonomous operation with no global autonomy switch, preserving no-change decisions, risk budgets, action receipts, verification, outcome measurement, and rapid containment.
non_goals: removing human approval from unproven write classes
acceptance_criteria: Each autonomous action class has its own G5 evidence, explicit G6 authorization, bounded blast radius, rollback, receipts, monitoring, and stop conditions.
The daily loop can select NO_CHANGE_RECOMMENDED and automatically blocks any action whose evidence, authorization, budget, precondition, or maturity state is insufficient.
A whole-system APIVR re-audit confirms no existing flagship, evidence, security, review, or claim boundary was weakened.
phases.rollback: Disable the affected autonomous action class immediately, preserve its evidence, and revert to shadow or draft maturity while the responsible phase is re-audited.
stop_conditions: Any action class lacks independent G5 canary evidence.
The system attempts to bypass a per-action maturity gate or human-only approval class.
Whole-system verification detects a regression or false-green capability claim.
